headline: On November 20, 1977: Sadat visits Israel
captionCards: 107 million people made Egypt the most populous Arab nation
First Arab leader to speak before Israel's Knesset in Jerusalem
instagramCaption:
Sadat made history in Jerusalem.

Egypt’s president became the first Arab leader to address Israel’s Knesset. He met Prime Minister Menachem Begin in Jerusalem, seeking a lasting peace. This visit occurred during Egypt’s time as the most populous Arab nation, with over 107 million people. The event marked a turning point in Middle East diplomacy.

It paved the way for the Camp David Accords and changed regional politics forever.
